profile_text.body:
Microsoft Research is the research organization of Microsoft, based in Redmond, Washington, and described in its own materials as a for-profit research lab. It says it conducts fundamental science and technology research across a spectrum of areas, with labs around the globe, and that it pursues breakthroughs across the computing and AI stack to accelerate discovery in the sciences and to create new foundations for others to build upon. Its site lists artificial intelligence, search and information retrieval, human language technologies, human-computer interaction, computer vision, graphics and multimedia, and audio and acoustics among its research areas, and presents publications, products, downloads, and research careers.

The available record does not list any specific AI products or MCP servers tied to Microsoft Research, so its position here rests on the research role its site describes rather than on named offerings. The record shows no lawsuits and a litigation count of 114 cases in Washington.
